stories.headline: PowNed drops 4-part hardstyle documentary HARD
stories.summary: Dutch broadcaster PowNed released all four episodes of HARD on NPO Start from Oct 29, tracing hardcore and hardstyle from late-80s illegal raves to global phenomenon. Pioneers DJ Rob, Paul Elstak and The Prophet feature throughout.

stories.headline: Dr. Peacock drops Frenchcore take on Mecano classic
stories.summary: Dutch Frenchcore artist Dr. Peacock has released his high-energy rework of Mecano's 'Hijo de la Luna', a track he's loved since childhood. The release follows its live debut at Harmony of Hardcore and is now on all streaming platforms.

stories.headline: FCKNYE Festival Returns Dec 30–Jan 1 in Brussels
stories.summary: FCKNYE Festival runs 30 Dec 2026–1 Jan 2027 at Brussels Expo, featuring Angerfist, Rebelion, Rooler and more across five stages. The event has grown from 2,000 attendees in 2010 to an expected 75,000 visitors.

stories.headline: Hardstyle.com Launches Premium Membership Tier
stories.summary: Hardstyle.com has introduced a premium subscription giving fans early music access and exclusive scene insights. Members also get special community perks and content unavailable to free users.

caption: Hardstyle docs, Frenchcore bangers, Brussels NYE chaos & a new era for Hardstyle.com — your weekly recap is here 🔥
